name: Post Reaction – let readers react to every post
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Give readers a one-click way to tell you how they feel – likes, loves, cares, and your own custom reactions, counted in real time on every post.

Plugin Demo | Request a new feature / Feedback

Why Post Reaction?

Comments take effort – reactions take one click. Post Reaction adds a Facebook-style reaction interface to your WordPress posts so visitors can instantly express how your content makes them feel, while you collect valuable engagement data.

Track and display various types of reactions, including likes, loves, cares, and even custom reactions you define yourself. The detailed reaction counts show you which posts resonate most with your audience, so you can tailor your content strategy for maximum impact.

To keep your data honest, the plugin enforces one-time reactions per user – each visitor can react to a post only once, preventing spammy or repetitive reactions. You can also customize the appearance and placement of the reaction area to suit your branding, whether you run a personal blog, a news site, or an online community.

Free Features

  • Any Post Type: Add post reactions to posts, pages, and custom post types.
  • Enable/Disable Reactions: Turn any individual reaction on or off.
  • Custom Reactions: Add your own reactions beyond like, love, and care.
  • Content Placement: Place content before or after the reactions area.
  • One-Time Reactions: Each user can react to a post only once, keeping counts accurate.
  • Real-Time Counts: Measure the impact of your posts as reactions come in.

How to Use – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Post Reaction plugin.
  2. Go to Tools → Post Reaction.
  3. Click Enable, choose which reactions to show, and add custom reactions if you like.
  4. Visit any post – the reaction bar is live and counting.

Use Cases

  • Blogs: See which articles readers love without waiting for comments.
  • News Sites: Capture instant sentiment on breaking stories.
  • Online Communities: Foster engagement with lightweight, familiar reactions.
  • Content Strategy: Use reaction counts as feedback to optimize future posts.

Developer Notes

For more information on how to contribute to this plugin, please visit our GitHub repository.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Post Reaction”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Tools → Post Reaction and click Enable.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools → Post Reaction to enable and configure reactions.
sections.faq:
How do I enable reactions on my posts?

After activating the plugin, go to Tools → Post Reaction and click Enable. The reaction interface then appears on your posts.

Can I use reactions on custom post types?

Yes. Post Reaction can be added to any post type, not just standard blog posts.

Can a visitor react to the same post multiple times?

No. The plugin enforces one-time reactions per user, so each visitor can react to a post only once – keeping your reaction data accurate and spam-free.

Can I add my own custom reactions?

Yes. Besides likes, loves, and cares, you can add custom reactions and enable or disable any reaction individually.

Can I show content around the reaction area?

Yes. You can place content before or after the reactions.
